name: soveral-soul-video
description: Vídeo de marca Soveral Soul (30s) — produzido em Remotion, render 100% local.

scripts.build: npm run build:wpp && npm run build:ig
scripts.build:wpp: remotion render SoveralSoul-Vertical-WhatsApp out/wpp-9x16.mp4 && remotion render SoveralSoul-Square-WhatsApp out/wpp-1x1.mp4 && remotion render SoveralSoul-Wide-WhatsApp out/wpp-16x9.mp4
scripts.build:ig: remotion render SoveralSoul-Vertical-Instagram out/ig-9x16.mp4 && remotion render SoveralSoul-Square-Instagram out/ig-1x1.mp4 && remotion render SoveralSoul-Wide-Instagram out/ig-16x9.mp4
